balls.text: full in length outside off, he leans forward and cracks it wide of deep extra cover
Mishra gets right across his stumps and tries to scoop it over short fine leg but poor choice of shot, the ball rolls away elsewhere
wild slog and the ball rolls to deep midwicket
Raina again! The captain's not letting go of any today, Bhatia swings a slower delivery across the line and Raina charges to his right and pulls it off one-handed, timed his jump well
one-handed! Bhatia is turning it on here, the slower ball is pitched short and he gets on his knee and swings him wide of deep square leg
now Joginder pitches it up and it's the same result! Free swing of the arms and he clears long-on this time
full toss, thanks you very much! At a good height for Bhatia to swing his arms and crash that over deep midwicket
tries to pound that over the on side but mistimes it to long-on
slower ball, he chips down the track and swings hard and misses, good change of pace
full on the off stump and hit hard to long-off
low full toss and pushed to long-on
fires it full and he plays all around that, the ball rolls to the on side
gets on his knee and sweeps him hard with one hand to deep square leg
gets forward and clips it off his pads
he pulls out the reverse sweep! No turn on that one, he gets in position early and slaps it well wide of short third man
punches it square of the wicket on the off side
punches it down to mid-on for a single
gets forward and drives him yo sweeper cover
pushes it down to point
the fuller delivery sends him back,close to a yorker length, Karthik bravely tries to sweep him away but the ball thuds his boot just outside the line of off stump
drops it short of a length and he swings hard and top edges, the ball drops short of two fielders who converge at deep midwicket
tries to paddle it fine but the ball clips his pads and rolls away, short fine leg cuts it off
gets forward and taps it to the off side
clipped to midwicket
gets forward and pushes it to the off side
checks his shot, the ball drops well short of the bowler
continues round the wicket, he chips it in the air to the wide open spaces at midwicket
lovely shot, it's a half volley on the off stump and he gets his bat behind the line and cracks it along the ground to wide long-off
full on the off stump and driven down to long-off
gives him width outside off, Manhas gets beside the line, rolls his wrists and cracks it wide of backward point, third man can't get to it
opens the face and taps it down to the off side
gets forward and jabs it down to long-on
Chennai will have to do something to plug that gap at third man, width offered and Karthik this time glides it to the right of short third man
tucks it down to long-on again
punches it to long-on
full on middle and leg and tucked down to long-on
tucks it down to square leg
opens the face and beats short third man again! Clever batting and Delhi are getting a quick move on here
angled to third man again, wrong line, opens the face of the bat and beats short third man
turns in and he clips him down to midwicket
width offered and he makes room and angles it down to third man, beats the fielder in the circle

The captain sets an example! Ashwin drags the ball short of a length and it doesn't bounce as much to de Villiers' liking, he pulls powerfully and Raina shows sharp reflexes at midwicket to fall to his right and pull it off
no turn at all, he goes back and punches him hard down to long-on
opens the face of the bat and dabs it wide of point
tucks it to long-on
makes room and dabs it to short third man

Kemp take a bow! Sehwag waltzes down the track and tries to clear long-off but makes contact off the splice of the bat, the ball swirls in the air and Kemp takes it one handed and falls backward just inches from the rope
tucked to the on side with soft hands and he takes a single
chips down the track and he tries to clear midwicket but he fails to keep it down, Raina's alert and he takes it easily
goes back and tucks it with the turn to midwicket
tucks him down to midwicket for a single
leans forward and places it to sweeper cover
gets forward and drives to long-off
down the leg side
drops it just a fraction short and he gets his bat behind the line and clubs it over deep midwicket
closes the face of the bat and he pushes it back to the bowler
full on middle and leg and pushes it hard down to long-on
rocks back and flat bats is down to long-on
just wide down the leg side
clips him down to short fine leg
rocks back and slaps it just wide of the non-striker,  down to long-off
tucks it towards midwicket
the doosra beats his off stump! That's how u can keep him quiet
keeps a bit low and he just manages to keep it out
makes room and jams it out to point
full outside off and driven to sweeper cover
tries to force it through the off side but misses
slower ball but too wide outside off
when the scoop doesn't come off it's not the prettiest sight is it? Hew tries to pick that from the off stump, the ball hits his arm
full on the off stump and he pushes it to long-off
that's too wide outside off and a full toss too, makes too much room and mistimes the slap to the off side
rocks back and tucks it to the on side
great shot! Relies on timing again, makes just a hint of room and deftly angles it wide of short third man
too wide down the leg side, doesn't offer a shot and the ball deflects off the keeper
just drops short! Murali dives forward to catch a mistimed punch, tough one
he gives him width this time, opens the face of the bat and glides it elegantly wide of backward point
comes round the wicket, tucks him up for room and he defends
scooped down to long-on, lot of power behind that shot
punches it wide of long-off and that;s his fifty! Off 22 balls
clipped off the pads for a leg bye
holds the length back, tucks him up and he takes a quick single to the off side
into the crowd! You can't pitch it up to Sehwag and get away with it, close to the pads and walloped over deep midwicket
good placement there! Not a bad delivery, Sehwag gets nicely beside the line and angles it just wide of backward point, great timing
good running, tapped with soft hands down to cover and sets off quickly
swishes too early and he swishes at thin air again,in fact this was quite close to taking the edge
wild swing but the makes contact of the toe of the bat, the ball rolls to the on side
clips it with soft hands to midwicket and takes a single
has the width to cut but he chops it to cover
Free Hit He takes a few paces forward and slaps a length ball wide of backward point, brings up the fifty in style
lovely shot, powerful bat speed on that one, full on middle and leg and he bangs it along the ground wide of mid-on, that's an overstep too
Direct hit but he's safe, pushes it to mid-on and they scramble the single,Murali hits at the bowler's end but Dilshan makes his ground, the third umpire takes a look
yorker length outside off and Dilshan fails to dig it out, Joginder appeals thinking Dilshan has edged it to the keeper
cuts it straight to cover
now the powerful horizontal bat shot, width outside off and he cuts past the gap at backward point and cover
full and swinging away, he chases it and chops it to the covers
gives him width and he slashes it hard along the ground down to square third man
gets forward and punches it straight to mid-off

that's a forehand crosscourt! Picked Hayden at midwicket, he fetches that from outside the off stump and flat-bats it, Hayden has to get across to his right to catch it, poor shot in the end, the bowling change works
he now angles it on the pads and he whips him away in the air, Ashwin jogs across at midwicket and stops it
Balaji is welcomed to the crease with a massive six, overpitched on the off stump and he lofts through the line over long-off
good ball, straight on the stumps and he has no room to free his arms, punched back to the bowler
opens the face of the bat and angles it to third man, quick single taken
he gives it another bang but hits it straight to the bowler
poor shot, swings at thin air and nearly loses his off stump, slower ball I think
more convincing this time, gets forward to a pitched up delivery and clips him high over midwicket, just short if a the rope
close call but he just manages to clear square leg, he plants his front foot forward and pulls over the outstretched arm of the fielder
tossed up this time, Sehwag mistimes his shot towards long-on, along the ground for a single
overpitched outside off, Sehwag cracks it past extra cover for four, lovely hit from Sehwag
pushed towards mid-off for a single
this time Warner finds the gap, backing away to make space to free his arms and drills it past extra cover
back of a length on legstump, Warner charges down the track, doesn't have the room to get behind that one, taps it towards cover
starts with a length ball on off, watchfully defended by Warner
again Albie errs by going full, Sehwag says 'thank you' and slams it over mid-off for the second boundary of the over
a big backlift - shaping for another big hit - but the length is shorter which means Sehwag can't slap it back down the ground as easily, pushed towards cover
Sehwag gets the first boundary, overpitched a bit, and a brutal hit over Albie's head, the crowd loves it
back of length on the pads, Sehwag flicks it towards midwicket in the circle
clipped from offstump towards deep midwicket, Warner's off the mark
short ball cut towards cover by Warner
that's an inside out six to finish things off! Makes room and scoops it high and hard over deep extra cover
tries to pull but the ball skids through and hits his pads

clips another full toss and he nearly fetches himself a four but Warner does really well to get across and stop it just in front of the rope, the momentum takes him past the rope but he releases the ball before that
Vijay creams a full toss! Sangwan bowls the worst possible delivery in this situation and Vijay gets all his power behind that shot, deep midwicket spectators have to take cover
drives firmly towards mid-off and dives full length at the crease, Mishra's throw is just wide
makes room and steers him wide of point
good shot by Vijay! He knew mid-on was up and he backed himself  to loft a slower ball comfortably over the fielder
tucked to deep midwicket, chance for a second run but they don't risk it
the middle stump is flattened! Nannes bowls it dead straight on middle and Kemp goes for a wild slog, misses it and loses the woodwork
gets on his knee and slams it to long-on
squirted out just wide of mid-off and he takes a chance with the single, he dives and the throw is just wide
beats him again just outside the off stump, nice angle away frpm the right hander
Kemp gently paddles it down to short fine leg, nice deft touch
drives him long-off
turns it to short fine leg and there's a fumble
another wide down the leg side, Delhi have bowled too many of those!
stays back and pulls hard along the turf
down the leg side and swept down to short fine leg
narrows the equation by six! Tossed up on middle and leg and slogged down to deep midwicket
doesn't control the pull, the ball rolls to short midwicket
rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket
tucks it straight to short midwicket
squirts it to midwicket
Do we have a twist here? Morkel goes back to a delivery pitched on a good length, the ball doesn't sit up too much and he ends up slapping it to midwicket, sharp catch
stays back and punches it past cover, Sehwag gets across and misfields
yorker length outside off and squeezed out to slip
punches it just past the bowler for a single
drags it wide outside off, he fails to make contact
tucks it straight to short fine leg
crisp timing there! Full and wide outside off and he doesn't drive too hard, finds the gap at deep extra cover
full outside the off stump and he reaches out a misses it
drifts down the leg side, fine leg is up and he gently tucks it around the corner, it was that easy
flighted on middle and flicked to the on side
rocks back and cuts to the off side

excellent catch by Dilshan! How crucial will that be? Flighted on middle and off and Hayden swings, he's not in full control of the shot and the ball dips towards Dilshan who falls forward and takes it inches off the turf at long-on
comes over the wicket and raina tries to sweep but misses
full outside off and driven down to long-off
fired on the pads and dug out to the on side
holds the length back and Hayden goes for a wild swish and misses
Nannes aims for the blockhole but it's a low full toss which Hayden puts away and picks the big gap at deep square leg
excellent yorker and well squeezed out by Raina, the ball rolls towards the keeper and they risk the single, Karthik's throw at the bowler's end is wide
Nannes struggles with his direction again, just a trifle wide down the leg side
yorker length on the pads and he squirts it out to square leg for a single
Nannes drifts too wide down the leg side, Hayden tries to clip it away
drifts down the leg side and he clips it straight to fine leg
googly and close to a wide again
too wide outside off, even two Mongoose bats won't be enough to chase that
even two grounds aren't enough for Hayden tonight! Mishra drops it on a length and Hayden rocks back and biffs it over deep midwicket
uses the wrists on that occasion to work it down to long-on
gets on the front foot and clips it firmly down to deep midwicket
tries to shovel a short delivery which keeps low, hits his back leg but outside the line of the leg stump
tossed up on middle and leg and tucked to the on side
forget about chasing that! Full and wide outside off and crashed past extra cover, the Mongoose bat is worth it after all
Hayden goes downtwon again! What a treat this is, pitched up on the off stump and an effortless free swing of the arms sends the ball over the sight screen
jams out a full delivery to the covers and a misfield by Mishra allows a single, Delhi aren't looking themselves at all
Raina has a swing and he connects! Pitched up on middle and leg and he lofts through the line just over the deep midwicket rope
yorker length on the off side and dug out
take cover! Hayden bashes one over deep midwicket again, the ball sits up nicely for him to club it away
good yorker! Just manages to dig it out
booming straight drive along the ground and nearly cleans up the umpire, AB does well to get across and stop it
full on middle and clipped to the on side
poor ball, the fine leg is up and he bowls a gentle length delivery on the leg stump, he effortlessly tucks it down to fine leg
jammed on the blockhole outside off and he bangs the pitch while trying to dig it out
mistimes the pull to deep midwicket
makes room and pushes it hard and quick to long-on
steers it with soft hands towards Dilshan at point and takes a sharp single
chases a full delivery swinging away from him, nearly edges it
good delivery on the blockhole, dug out to mid-off
can we have the ball back please? Tossed up on middle, hayden stays at the crease and executes the cleanest of strikes over deep midwicketm that's his fifty
tossed up again and he comes down the track and launches him over midwicket
opens the face and glides it to short third man
drives to long-on
The best we've seen yet of the Mongoose! Flighted on the off stump and Hayden gets the bat down hard and bashes it high and hard over long-off
smart field placement! Yadav drops it short of a length on the off stump, Badri tries to club it over the on side but finds Mishra who takes it comfortably at short midwicket
taps it in front of cover ad sets off
doesn't bounce much and the ball hits him close to the abdomen and rolls to the on side
another full toss and intelligently played, outside off and instead of biffing it he plays it with an angled bat and steers it wide of backward point, the ball races past third man
wide and swinging away, it's a low full toss which he cracks to sweeper cover
full and wide outside off and left alone
the ball is pitched up and Badri gets under the bounce and scoops it over the bowler's head and wide of long-on
tries to crack it past midwicket but mistimes it to mid-on

Run-out appeal! Hayden pushes the ball to mid-off and challenges Mishra by going for the single, the fielder picks up and fires a direct hit at the bowler's end and Hayden is just in with the dive, third umpire takes a look
too full and wide outside off and Hayden decides not to offer a shot
punches it in front of mid-off with soft hands and sets off
full on the off stump and pushed towards cover point
doesn't time it as well, he goes for the maximum over long-on but he wasn't fully in control, Warner makes a valiant attempt diving to his right but the ball beats hime
down the leg side and he gets a faint trickle down to fine leg, wide of the fielder in the circle
maximum this time! Pitched up on middle, a very friendly length from Bhatia and Hayden lofts a dead straight six! Take that!
the first boundary with the Mongoose bat! Drifts on the pads and he gets on his knee and sweeps past the big gap wide of short fine leg
full on the off stump and pushed to mid-off
drives on the front foot but can't pierce the gap at extracover, packed off side field there
opens the face and angles it to the off side
gets forward and tucks it back to the bowler
lovely shot! Overpitched on the off stump and he merely pushes it through the line wide of mid-off, beats the fielder
so much for the first sighting, he mistimes it to the on side, tries to whack it across the line
Sangwan swings it towards off and middle and hayden flicks him wide of short fine leg
full on the off stump and dug out
angles wide across the right-hander, reaches out and cuts straight to backward point
the slower ball beats him outside the off stump, well bowled
tucks it towards midwicket
full outside off and he gets forward and angles it to third man

AB! Patel nearly loses his balance while digging out a yorker, the ball rolls towards short midwicket and Hayden doesn't want the single because there wasn't one in the first place, AB swoops and under-arms the throw to the batsman's end
this time he drops it on a length and Hayden shovels it just over midwicket's grasp, the fielder had barely enough time to react
chops it back to the bowler
fetch that! Full in length on middle and off and creamed past the bowler, the ball scorches past the turf
Dropped and a misfield!  Hayden biffs it hard at the bowler who gets his right hand to it and deflects it to mid-off, sloppy effort by the fielder as the ball goes right between his legs
wide outside off and cut to third man
terrific first delivery! Viscious inswing to the left-hander on a yorker length, Patel just manages to dig it out to fine leg
mistimed drive off the front foot to cover point, there's a direct hit at the bowler's end and the batsmen take an overthrown off the deflection
keeps it on a good length outside off and Hayden is happy to let it go, you can sense a big hit somewhere
holds the length back and he safely lets it go
taps it with soft hands to the off side and sets off
a touch wide outside the off stump, he shoulders arms
nips back in and slices him in half! Superb delivery and well kept
full and quick outside off and left alone
